assumptions: Psi4 calls complete successfully with documented return values and molecule updates.
Each calculation uses a private clone and native option defaults plus the declared model and calculation settings.
Option isolation covers native modules and explicitly named option modules. Unlisted plugin state, process resources, and concurrent option mutation remain outside this contract.
Geometry equality means shared provenance, not numerical or physical equivalence.
Energy formulas use exact real arithmetic; floating-point errors are not bounded.
Primary return values have the declared quantity types; their physical interpretation depends on application capability evidence.
Electronic-state suitability, convergence, and scientific accuracy are outside the encoded construction claims.
